published.en: Participation policy. Age is measured in completed whole years at the recorded submission timestamp. To determine eligibility, an applicant is disqualified exactly when at least one of these two statements is true: they are younger than 25, or they are not a resident. Anyone not disqualified by this test is eligible. In addition, the system must record the submission no later than 2027-05-23T08:45:00Z (UTC), including that exact instant. Acceptance requires eligibility and compliance with the deadline. There are no other conditions or exceptions.

Toda persona no excluida por esta prueba es elegible. Además, el sistema debe registrar la presentación a más tardar el 2027-05-23T08:45:00Z (UTC), incluido ese instante exacto. La aceptación exige elegibilidad y cumplimiento del plazo. No hay otras condiciones ni excepciones.
